known_issues: Unable to load Nakshatras - backend canister may be stopped or initializing

existing_features.title: Add proper error handling and retry logic in useQueries.ts to gracefully handle canister initialization delays. Display user-friendly loading states while the backend initializes instead of showing error messages.

new_feature_requests.summary: Investigate and fix the backend canister initialization issue causing 'Unable to Load Nakshatras' error. Ensure the main.mo actor initializes properly and responds to frontend queries without timing out or showing 'service temporarily unavailable' errors.
Verify that the default Nakshatras (Ashwini and Bharani) are properly initialized in main.mo during canister deployment and can be retrieved immediately after startup.
